name: system-design-signaling-server
description: Standalone y-webrtc signaling server for this project's collaborative editing feature. Deliberately a separate, minimal package from the main app - a signaling server has nothing to do with React/Vite, it only needs y-webrtc's own bundled server itself. See the main project README's 'Collaborative editing' section for how to point the app at wherever this ends up deployed.
